- Each Hollow Halls chest now belongs to one hall, so a hall's World Map and minimap no longer show chests from a neighbouring hall. Seven gold and silver chests on ledges and in secret rooms now show on their own hall's map.
- On the overworld, wooden chests and resource icons now thin out only as you zoom, no longer as you pan.
- With Town Portals 1.0.13, players show on the minimap in the colour they picked with its PortalColor setting.
Reported bugs fixed:
- Chests from other Hollow Halls showed on a hall's map (reported by Lomack02).
- Some chests on a hall's map appeared and disappeared as you panned. Hall maps now draw every chest.
